title: The Divinity: False Seek Of Divine
body:
_**THE DIVINITY**_
![The Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7e5e12148efdd053899c4ac00ddeb27b0de4c71.png)


   Welcome to "The Divinity" a mod focusing on adding a new dimension and bunch of      content inspired from ULTRAKILL and other kinds of holy stuff 
   The mod introduces 
   5 Mobs
   New Blocks
   Plants
   Biomes
   A Dimension
   Toolsets
   & Structures ( Alot )

                                  HOW TO BEGIN:
![A Holystone Well in a Desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51316825e069dc79e8b0b08d57a0c94f92614e0f.png)
While exploring through the world, you might come across with a new structure called holystone well, inside you will find the Hope Shard and other related items to begin, after that. Venture out to the nether in order to collect some havocite in order to make havocite ingots. Then combine these into one to make a Holystone and Scrap to light a portal that resides underground...
![An Irresistible Call of the Eldritch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ced0ac1a2660e04a1354c15142a9532d81921999_0.webp)
After that go through it and start your exploration














        THE LORE


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Once Uppon A Time..
After releasing the Wither to the overworld, the ancient builders made the ancient cities to study and find the weapon in order to destroy what they unleashed to the world.
And then they made the ancient city portals by following steps they learned from artifacts, these portal had led them to somewhere so unexpected that they were in shock
It was limbo, a place filled with food, vegetation, peacefull landscape and a bright sun. This place was filled with resources, enough resources to defeat Wither


And so, they did it... They managed to kill the beast.
The mission was a succses and everything was going fine until they saw a break, a false generation, a fraud

The geography of limbo was exact to the overworld, the plants were mostly identical and some generations were broken and nonsensical
Then the saw "it"

Two eyeballs watching them from the skies. Two massive eyeball
And then for unknown reasons. The humankind has gone extinct
As the portals shut, it leaked in the material as we know as "Sculk" to the overworld

The knowledge about the entry is still mostly unkown but it is said to be the limbo is a massive beast trying its best to lure in adventurers by its fake paradise and nutriens

It is also said to be this massive creature tries its best to replicate our reality by its formations and landscape for unkown reasons
There are still non discovered features in limbo 
Only to be discovered

</details>
